custodian_role: independent evaluator agent session heldout_custodian; not benchmark intent author or scored author

endpoint_status.approval: owner must explicitly freeze the proposed alternative and 10 percentage point improvement/zero added valid-behavior rejection safeguard before scoring; not a retrospective substitute for original endpoint
endpoint_status.original_mutant_fault_detection: unmeasured; controls are qualified independently but no author mutation-injection/detection campaign exists
endpoint_status.proposed_alternative: held-out case discrepancy union: decision discrepancy OR applicable SMT relation discrepancy for proof cohorts; runtime decision discrepancy for other cohorts
endpoint_status.threshold_claim: No threshold outcome measured or claimed.

exposure: Custodian read public intent, interface, public calibration examples and protocol; no scored author outputs read.
Coordinator and authors must not inspect private files. Root/host administrators can access the same host; provider/session separation does not provide independent organization or model family.
Public examples crosschecked for oracle qualification and excluded by exact episode/input identity from heldouts; semantic boundary themes can overlap.
No public feasibility fixture was imported or used as heldout input.
No human product owner or formal methods expert has validated oracle/cases; owner proposed intent remains pending G1.
limitations: Mutation fixtures are independently classified output/relation controls with direct witness comparisons, including two noneligible control categories; no executable contract mutation injection/campaign or author fault-detection score implemented.
Contradiction/vacuity controls are finite witness sanity checks; no general contradiction/vacuity assurance.
Runtime frame checks cover returned status/used/owner only; other reservations, persistence, hidden writes and audit retention lack executable state and are outside this oracle.
Dependency/evidence freshness and B5/B6 documentary continuity need separate evaluator review; unchanged decisions are sampled, not proof of dependency closure.
model_identity: Codex GPT-6 agent; exact serving model/provider revision not exposed to this session

qualification.mutation_coverage: qualified output/relation fixtures only; not executable mutation campaign

requalification_history.change_review: INTERFACE report.json readiness status/unresolved_decisions fields only; fixed decision and Step signatures/input/output semantics unchanged. Author instructions add matching handoff declaration.
Author instructions exact report fields list now explicitly includes already-required status and unresolved_decisions; no decision/Step/intent/example change.
requalification_history.qualification_basis: Prior readiness requalification remains applicable; unchanged intent/interface/example pins and all private commitments verified.

scoring: Use combined cases.json; optional schedule selects submission seed17 or29. Formal relation applies only to full correctly typed inputs; runtime malformed-input rejection is evaluated separately. Finite input evidence is not universal correctness.

storage.author_access: must be excluded by author mount namespace; discretionary same-user permissions alone are insufficient
storage.recovery: if lost or source pins change, stop scored use and requalify/recommit before author work; never silently regenerate after outcomes
storage.retention: retain through frozen-output evaluation, separate review, publication decision and reproducibility retention; no automatic deletion
storage.reveal: no private oracle, inputs or answers to authors/coordinator before all scored outputs and attempts freeze; later reveal only by explicit owner release decision
